notes.title: Echoes III - back with a bang and in 3D!
notes.content:
If you liked 1982 and Echoes+ from Binary Zoo you're going to love Echoes III...!

The retro arcade game is back with a bang and this time in 3D! More intense and eye bleeding than before, with the action coming at you from the sides, above and below.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/841950/Echoes_III
Retaining the great game-play as before, Echoes III is now in full 3D! There are five solar systems to play in and for each you can choose to play in one of the four games modes (Echoes, Survivor, Speed Run and Big Bang). Unlock the game's achievements to win upgrades, this will help you score higher and survive longer.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29369297/4d7d0ab59a8d2f83b0f3e9df32610e251884f9bb.jpg[/img]

Echoes III is an intense retro style shoot-em-up game. The action is non-stop as you blast your way through ever increasingly intense solar system levels. Improve your chances by picking up weapon upgrades, shield boosts and smart bombs. With 4 game modes and 5 different solar systems there are 20 ways to play.

Echoes III is a showcase game made using AppGameKi. You can learn more about AppGameKit HERE:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/325180/AppGameKit_Easy_Game_Development/

[b]Four great game modes[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7626302/67d55b8b2df6d8119be0b99ea7e79851e82fd8d2.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Echoes[/b]
This classic Echoes mode is all about scoring as many points as you can; boosting your weapons, shield and score multiplayer as you play
[*][b]Survivor[/b]
With only one life how long can you survive?
[*][b]Speed Run[/b]
Kill the required number of enemies to progress to the next level. Kill the sun to stop the clock!
[*][b]Big Bang Mode[/b]
Using only bombs score as many points as you can. Pick up bomb parts to build more bombs
[/list]
[b]Five super solar systems[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7626302/176e2d4e29c7334832ec73c8b385366d512e5631.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Class 1C[/b]
This is a peaceful solar system, featuring mainly asteroids and shooting stars
[*][b]Siberian[/b]
Orbiting around a cool system this one contains many frozen objects and a few quasars
[*][b]Anarchy[/b]
A very unstable system with super nova and even a neutron star!
[*][b]Viper[/b]
A chaotic system featuring a number of asteroid belts. Scientists believe dark matter may be present here
[*][b]Hades[/b]
With a giant star this is a system of violent flaming comets, asteroid belts and other chaotic material
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29369297/64f4cb06602226599f9fd5b8653fed5b78ff1acb.jpg[/img]

[b]Steam Achievements and Steam Leaderboards![/b]
Unlock Steam achievements to help you survive longer and score higher in the Steam leaderboards.

Echoes III has been developed by Binary Zoo with cool retro music by Anti-Lag

Take a look at the showcase video showing Echoes III in all its retro arcade glory HERE

[b]Come join the retro-inspired arcade action and blast your way to through the ever increasing chaos![/b]

[b]Buy Echoes III here with a special launch discount:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/841950/Echoes_III

notes.title: Echoes+ Updated!
notes.content:
After a successful launch we're now bringing you updates for both PC and Mac versions of Echoes+

Thanks for all your feedback and positive comments.

[h1]PC Revisions V8[/h1]
[list]
[*] fixed the Play My Music feature
[*] added diagonals to keyboard movement (where supported by hardware)
[*] added diagonals to keyboard firing (where supported by hardware)
[*] instructions updated
[*] online high-score code updated
[*] increased high-score digit display
[*] screen resolution calculation changed
[/list]

[h1]Mac Revisions V2[/h1]
[list]
[*] fixed the game freezing on Yosemite OS
[*] added joypad configuration option
[*] added diagonals to keyboard movement (where supported by hardware)
[*] added diagonals to keyboard firing (where supported by hardware)
[*] instructions updated
[*] online high-score code updated
[*] increased high-score digit display
[*] screen resolution calculation changed
[/list]

Please keep feeding back about the game!
